title: Marc Hijink on ASML’s Culture, Supply Chain, and Geopolitics
content: Explore how ASML’s partner-driven culture, EUV dominance, and geopolitical pressures reshaped chipmaking in Marc Hijink’s interview. The post Marc Hijink on ASML’s Culture, Supply Chain, and Geopolitics appeared first on EE Times .

title: AMD telco chief says GPU 'backlash' is coming in AI-RAN
content: Putting data center GPUs into the RAN would not make sense, says AMD's Piotr Weglicki, promoting his company's CPUs as the power-efficient answer.

title: NTT, ispace forge alliance for Earth-to-Moon connectivity
content: NTT and ispace are developing ultra-long-distance optical communication systems and laser-based wireless power transmission systems for use in deep space and on the Moon.

title: NVDA: Earnings Call: Q3 2027
content: Q3 FY27 revenue hit a record $116B, with data center demand and the Vera Rubin ramp driving strong growth. FY28 revenue growth guidance rose to ~75%; supply constraints, export controls, and CEO succession remain key considerations.
